name: calendar

scripts.conformance: npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract calendar.list --args '{"account":"default"}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract calendar.events --args '{"account":"default","from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-01-07"}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract calendar.create --args '{"account":"default","calendar":"Work","title":"test","start":"2026-01-01T10:00:00"}'

description: CAK 插件：CalDAV 日历（calendar.list / calendar.events 只读 + calendar.create 建日程）
